Question 18

The line x+y=2 intercepts the x- and y-axes at points A and B, respectively. If the segment AB― is a diameter of the circle, find the equation of the circle.

a
 (x−1)2+(y−2)2=4
b
(x−2)2+(y−1)2=2
c
(x−2)2+(y−2)2=2
d
 (x−2)2+(y−2)2=4
e
(x−1)2+(y−1)2=2
